query: Create a bar chart to compare the Preqin Median Net IRR and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR for each Vintage year.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
bar_width = 0.35
index = df['Vintage']
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
bar1 = ax.bar(index, df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], bar_width, label='Preqin Median Net IRR')
bar2 = ax.bar(index + bar_width, df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], bar_width, label='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
plt.xlabel('Vintage Year')
plt.ylabel('Values')
plt.title('Comparison of Preqin Median Net IRR and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR by Vintage Year')

plt.legend()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Vintage', 'y_fields': ['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], 'chart_type': 'barChart'}

query: Create a combo chart with a line and bar to show the Preqin Median Net IRR as a line and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR as bars over the Vintage years.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()
ax1.bar(df['Vintage'], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], color='b', label='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
ax1.set_xlabel('Vintage Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('LN PME Using S&P 500 TR', color='b')
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(df['Vintage'], df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], color='r', marker='o', label='Preqin Median Net IRR')
ax2.set_ylabel('Preqin Median Net IRR', color='r')
plt.title('Combo Chart of Preqin Median Net IRR and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
fig.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Vintage', 'y_fields': ['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], 'chart_type': 'comboChart'}
plt.show()
